exposure: Mercury exposure (chronic, measured by urinary mercury level)
outcome: Oxidative stress (measured by blood antioxidant activity)
cohort: The participants were 64 pregnant dental staff (exposed group) and 60 pregnant employees (non-exposed group).
finding: Pregnant dental staff experienced higher mean urinary mercury levels, lower blood antioxidant activity, and more frequently suffered from spontaneous abortion, pre-eclampsia, and gave birth to babies smaller for gestational age.
birth_weight: Assessed in relation to gestational age (babies smaller for gestational age).
gest_age: Used to classify babies as 'smaller for gestational age'.
